# Standard Set

Version 0.0.1 · Owners: [@benallfree](https://github.com/benallfree)

The extensions every PocketOne app has: settings, API tokens (with the OAuth server), remotes (remote/v1), MCP,
PocketPages, S3 redirects, point-in-time restore, backups, bulk mail and deploy. The stock `pocketone` binary and every Pocker instance use it,
so an app never misses one because its host forgot to list it. Members can be reconfigured or turned off per app,
never removed.

[Install](#install) · [Configure](#configure) · [Use](#use) · [Integrations](#integrations) · [Example](#example)

## Install

The standard set is built into `pocketone`. In your own Go build, make the app with it instead of
`pocketbase.New()`:

```go
set := standard.New()
app := set.NewApp(pocketbase.Config{}, jsvm.Config{HooksDir: "pb_hooks"})
app.Start()
```

`NewApp` registers the members, loads `pb_hooks` with their JS APIs (`$mcp`, `$tokens`, `$bulkmail`) and resolves
their contracts. On an app you built yourself, call `set.Register(app, jsvmConfig)` instead.

## Configure

- **Reconfigure a member:** replace it, e.g. `set.PITR = pitr.New(pitr.Config{Retention: 7 * 24 * time.Hour})`. A
  member set to nil is an error.
- **Turn one off:** `enabled: false` in its `pocketone.yaml` section, or in an instance's `extensions.<name>` under
  Pocker. Extensions that require it turn off too, and say why.
- **Add your own:** `set.Add(myextension.New())`. Extras register after the members, under the same rules.
- **Pick providers:** `set.Providers` is `pocketone.yaml`'s `providers:` section, for a contract more than one
  extension provides.

### pocketone.yaml reference

#### `providers:`

Which extension provides a contract when several do.

## Use

Each app logs what it got when it starts:

```
standard: on: settings, tokens, remotes, mcp, pages, s3redirect, pitr, backups, bulkmail, deploy
standard: tokens/v1 ← tokens
```

With remotes off (deploy requires its remote/v1):

```
standard: remotes off: enabled: false
standard: deploy off: needs remote/v1, which nothing provides
```

## Integrations

| With | What happens |
|---|---|
| [Pocker](https://pocketone.dev/docs/extensions/pocker) | Every instance gets the set (`Server.Standard`), with its own `extensions.<name>` settings. |
| [Contracts](https://pocketone.dev/docs/contracts/all) | Members find each other through contracts (`tokens/v1`), resolved per app; the startup lines show who provides what. |

## Example

```go
// A PocketOne app with the standard set and one extra extension: run it with `go run . serve`.
package main

import (
	"log"
	"time"

	"ganigeorgiev.com/pocketbase/pocketbase"
	"github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/jsvm"
	"github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/mailtrap"
	"github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/pitr"
	"github.com/pockethost/pocketone/ext/standard"
)

func main() {
	set := standard.New()
	set.PITR = pitr.New(pitr.Config{Retention: 7 * 24 * time.Hour}) // reconfigure a member
	set.Add(mailtrap.New())                                         // add your own

	app := set.NewApp(pocketbase.Config{}, jsvm.Config{HooksDir: "pb_hooks"})
	if err := app.Start(); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
```
